query: SELECT fp.id, fp.roomName, fp.bagsInstalled, COUNT(fps.id) as spot_count FROM floorPlans fp LEFT JOIN floorPlanSpots fps ON fp.id = fps.floorPlanId GROUP BY fp.id, fp.roomName, fp.bagsInstalled ORDER BY fp.createdAt DESC LIMIT 10;
